title: Sash-panel micro-guides & contextual doc-chips for first-run
creator: Amira Patel
description: Design a slim, dismissible sash-panel (slide-over) that surfaces 2–3 micro-guides and contextual doc-link chips during a user's first run after a release. The sash should be non-modal, persistently available for the session, and safely dismissible. It will complement (not replace) existing onboarding flows by providing: 1) immediate pointers to high-value console actions (create API key, try generation, view billing), 2) contextual doc links that open inline docs or full docs in a new tab, and 3) a tiny screenshot gallery for release notes and marketing assets. This ticket covers comps, accessibility annotations, screenshot capture checklist, and dev handoff specs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma comps for sash-panel in both light and dark themes with annotated spacing/token usage
Responsive specs: mobile (320w), tablet (768w), desktop (1280w+) with breakpoint behaviors
Annotated accessibility notes: keyboard focus order, role/aria attributes, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for text on chips
Microcopy finalized for 3 chips (Primary task, Docs, Quick Tour) and captured in i18n-friendly format
Screenshot assets captured for release channel (3 sizes each) and exported to release drive folder
Handoff checklist complete and linked GitHub ticket created for engineering work
Instrumentation spec included (events: sash_shown, sash_dismissed, chip_clicked, screenshot_downloaded)
tasks: Design sash-panel anatomy and visual system in Figma (frames + components)
Create doc-chip component variants (icon, badge, external link affordance)
Write microcopy and i18n notes for placeholders and CTAs
Produce release screenshot set and annotate cropping/overlay rules
Export annotated redlines and tokens for dev handoff
Coordinate with Eng to validate z-index/portal strategy and lazy-load icons
Run accessibility pass with S&G before finalizing comps
comments: 2025-02-05 — Amira: Initial exploration uploaded to Figma. Two sash widths proposed: 360px (compact) and 480px (expanded). Prototype links attached.
2025-02-06 — Jordan (PM): Prefer compact to reduce visual noise. Request adding a persistent "help" affordance in the console header to reopen sash after dismissal.

2025-02-07 — Ravi (Eng): Flagged potential stacking context issues with existing toast system. Suggested using a dedicated portal div and z-index 9000. Also recommends deferring screenshot thumbnails until after initial token generation to avoid blocking render.

2025-02-09 — Accessibility review (S&G): Ensure chips are buttons with aria-describedby where necessary; avoid focus traps — sash should be tabbable but not modal. Contrast tweaks suggested for secondary text on dark theme.
2025-02-11 — Amira: Updated Figma with dark theme adjustments, added analytics spec, and uploaded screenshot export checklist to Drive. Preparing handoff package.
